userStories.title: Create canonical graph schema tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need canonical relational tables for graph records so later UI, AI, and reasoning features share one consistent data model.
acceptanceCriteria: Tables exist for entities, claims, claim arguments, notes, sources, source excerpts/citations, schema definitions/versions, rule definitions, proposals, audit events, jobs, and `graph_outbox`.

userStories.notes: Canonical graph schema tables added in apps/api/src/db/schema.ts (migration drizzle/0003_massive_kronos.sql): schema_definitions, schema_versions, entities, claims, claim_arguments, notes, sources, source_excerpts, rule_definitions, proposals, jobs, graph_outbox (audit_events already existed from US-004). All canonical graph records use PG18-native UUIDv7 PKs (uuidv7() default), knowledge_base_id FK, created_at/updated_at, nullable deleted_at soft-delete, created_by; JSONB properties/metadata/provenance/spec default '{}'/'[]'. Entities/claims carry nullable schema_version_id (validated-against version; nullable so US-008/009 can precede custom schemas US-027) + conceptual string type/predicate for cross-version search. Claims are multi-argument via claim_arguments (role-labeled, entity ref OR literal value, check-constrained) — not binary edges. Notes & Sources are first-class canonical records, not entity rows. DB check constraints (confidence 0..1, valid-time order, span order, excerpt single-origin, entity not-self-merge, status enums) + partial unique indexes (deleted_at IS NULL) for recreatable schema defs/rules + helpful indexes. graph_outbox has projection-state (status/attempts/last_error/run_after) for US-006; jobs has status/attempts/max_attempts/run_after/failure_reason/owner_user_id for US-007. Custom-property validation HOOK validateCustomProperties(propertySchema, properties) + built-in entity types + status enums in packages/schemas/src/graph.ts (8 unit tests). New graph-schema.integration.test.ts (skipIf no DATABASE_URL) verifies all 12 tables exist, inserts entities/multi-arg claim/notes/sources/outbox with UUIDv7 ids, and confirms the confidence check constraint rejects out-of-range values. Verified: pnpm verify fully green; live compose DB db:migrate applied 0003, all integration tests pass, \dt confirms all tables.

Stubbed state visible: createApp logs stub notice once/process (module flag, avoids test flood) + status endpoint exposes stubbed:true. requireAdmin now exported from auth/index.ts. createApp seams now {checkDatabase,authStore,kbStore,projectionStore,projector}. userStories.title: Add PostgreSQL-backed jobs foundation
userStories.description: As an operator, I need durable jobs so projection, AI, embeddings, imports, and exports do not depend on process-local state.
acceptanceCriteria: PostgreSQL-backed job table supports status, attempts, retry-after, failure reason, owner user, and `knowledge_base_id` when applicable.

userStories.notes: Durable PostgreSQL-backed jobs foundation. jobs table already existed (US-005); added apps/api/src/jobs/: store.ts (JobStore interface + dbJobStore; claimNext = FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED inside tx then status=running + attempts++ so multiple workers never double-claim; enqueue/markSucceeded/markForRetry/markFailed/getById/list/countByStatus), worker.ts (computeBackoffMs capped exponential base 1s cap 5min; runNextJob runs handler for job.type, success->markSucceeded, throw->markForRetry with runAfter=now+backoff until attempts>=maxAttempts then markFailed dead-letter, missing handler->immediate dead-letter; processAvailableJobs drain; runWorkerLoop + startInProcessWorker for the two run modes), handlers.ts (defaultJobHandlers registry incl noop), worker-process.ts (separate-process entry, graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM, WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS). index.ts createJobsRouter at /api/jobs: GET / (list, ?status/?knowledgeBaseId/?limit), GET /stats (per-status counts), GET /:id (404) -- all system admin only (read-only). Run modes: pnpm --filter @jotmind/api worker (separate process) + WORKER_INLINE=true starts startInProcessWorker in server.ts. Shared schemas packages/schemas/src/jobs.ts (publicJob, jobListQuery, jobStats; reuses jobStatusSchema from graph.ts). createApp seam now includes jobStore. Tests: jobs.test.ts (backoff math, runNextJob success/no-handler/retry-then-deadletter with injected clock, processAvailableJobs summary, admin API auth/403/list+filter/400/stats/get+404) + jobs.integration.test.ts (skipIf no DATABASE_URL, TRUNCATEs jobs/knowledge_bases/users). Verified: pnpm verify fully green; live compose DB db:migrate + 69 tests pass (incl integration); separate-process worker smoke-tested end-to-end (claimed+ran noop job -> succeeded with result).
